title: Ulyana and the Portrait
author: Kestrel Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
